class.name: GameplayAttributeSet
class.brief_description: Bounded numerical attributes and source-keyed modifiers inspired by Unreal Gameplay Ability System.
class.description: An attribute stores a base value and minimum/maximum bounds. Modifiers identified by (source, attribute) each contribute an additive amount and percentage bonus. Evaluation is [code]clamp((base + sum(additive)) * max(0, 1 + sum(percent)), min, max)[/code], independent of modifier insertion order. Results are cached until any change. Instances have at most 64 attributes and 256 modifiers. Numerical input is checked for overflow and non-finite values. Server simulation must remain authoritative for gameplay; clients may aggregate presentation values from replicated snapshots.

method.name: set_base_value
method.description: Creates or updates an attribute's base value. Absolute values must be at most one billion.

method.name: set_bounds
method.description: Sets inclusive value bounds on an existing attribute. The minimum must not exceed the maximum.

method.name: set_modifier
method.description: Sets a modifier identified by its source and attribute. Reapplying the same pair replaces it rather than stacking invisibly. Percent must be between -1 and 8. Returns false for invalid input or missing attribute.

method.name: remove_modifier
method.description: Removes exactly one source/attribute modifier, returning whether it existed.

method.name: clear_source
method.description: Removes all modifiers from this source and returns their number.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the computed, bounded value of an attribute, or zero if absent.

method.name: get_base_value
method.description: Returns the original base value, without any modifiers.

method.name: get_modifier_count
method.description: Returns the number of source/attribute modifiers.

method.name: get_snapshot
method.description: Returns an independent snapshot with attributes (tag keys mapped to base/min/max dictionaries) and modifiers (an array of source/attribute/additive/percent dictionaries).

method.name: replace_snapshot
method.description: Atomically replaces all attributes and modifiers after validating every entry. An invalid snapshot leaves previous state and cached values unchanged.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears all attributes, modifiers and cached values.
